data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to integrate Facebook Meta SDK for app events and deep links.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bridge to the native Facebook/Meta SDKs so you can log app events and handle deep links from Flutter. It works on Android and iOS and requires native configuration of app IDs and tokens.
use_when: you need Facebook app‑event tracking in a Flutter app
you want deep‑link handling via the Meta SDK
avoid_when: you only need generic analytics without Facebook
you cannot modify native iOS/Android files
strengths: keeps the native Facebook SDK up‑to‑date
data.setup_notes: Add FacebookAppID, FacebookClientToken and URL schemes to iOS Info.plist; add meta-data entries to AndroidManifest and string resources; provide app ID and token in code.
